intro: Manage your store’s products, availability and images.
empty: Change your filters or create a new product.
detailsIntro: The name and description will be visible in both store languages.
name: Name
slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Maximum 64 characters.
slugTaken: This address is already in use. Choose another one.
nameItHint: Enter the Italian name, up to 120 characters.
nameEnHint: Enter the English name, up to 120 characters.
descriptionItHint: Enter the Italian description, up to 2000 characters.
descriptionEnHint: Enter the English description, up to 2000 characters.
priceHint: Enter a price in euros with no more than two decimal places.
piecesHint: Enter a positive whole number, or leave empty.
publicationHint: Only active products are visible in the store.
created: The product has been created. You can now add images.
imagesIntro: Images will appear in the order they were uploaded.
imageHint: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP file, up to 5 MB.
invalidImage: The file is not a valid image. Choose another file.
imageMissing: This image is no longer available. Refresh the page.
noImages: This product has no images yet.
imagesAfterCreate: Save the product to add images.
invalidForm: Check the information you entered and try again.
usersIntro: Review customer cards and suspend accounts.
userSuspended: {{name}}'s account is suspended and can no longer sign in.
